text: Databases are organised systems for storing and managing information. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables, which look like spreadsheets with rows and columns. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different formats, such as documents. To get information from a database, you use queries, which are special commands that ask questions about the data. Data modeling is the process of planning how data is structured and connected before you build the database. Indexes help make queries faster by allowing the database to find information quickly without searching every row.
